Hi everyone! Quick question about driving in Israel with a foreign license.
Im in the process of getting a partner visa (not have the date for my B/1 interview yet). I arrived last week on a B/2 tourist visa (valid for 1 month) after clearing entry.

My background: Lived and studied in Israel from 2016–2023 on a student visa. Got my Vietnamese driver’s license in July 2024 and changed it to International Driving Permit (IDP).

Can I drive here in Israel legally with my Vietnamese license + IDP for the first 6–12 months?

Thanks in advance for any advice or experiences! 🙏
